newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria inoculates children against polio.
newsitem.headline: Algeria inoculates children against polio.

text.p: Algerian health services said on Wednesday they were inoculating 107,000 children under five years of age against polio in the province of Relizane, west of the capital Algiers.
They said in two reports carried by the Algerian news agency APS that 51,307 children were also being vaccinated against the disease in Khenchela, southeast of the capital.
The operations are part of the national anti-polio days.
